predict: TracLLM is a generic framework for attributing long context Large Language Models (LLMs). It is designed to identify the specific parts of a given context that are responsible for a particular output generated by an LLM. This framework can be used to improve the transparency and accountability of LLMs by tracing which sections of the input context contribute to the model's responses. TracLLM is presented as a method to go beyond simply identifying incorrect answers, providing a more detailed understanding of how LLMs process and respond to long contexts.
